announcements.headline: EQS-News: AUTO1 Group appoints Jörg Pietzner as Chief Financial Officer
announcements.insight: AUTO1 Group appoints Jörg Pietzner as CFO. He was elected to the Supervisory Board in June, indicating a shift in his role within the company.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: AUTO1 Group reports record Q3 2026 profitability with adjusted EBITDA up 46%
announcements.insight: Record Q3 profitability follows strong Q2 growth. This confirms sustained operational improvement for shareholders.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: AUTO1 Group reports strong Q2 2026 unit and profitability growth
announcements.insight: Strong Q2 unit and profitability growth follows recent segment targets and financing. This signals execution of the outlined strategy to shareholders.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: AUTO1 Group successfully prices its third consumer car loan ABS: FinanceHero 3
announcements.insight: AUTO1 Group successfully prices its third consumer car loan ABS. This follows earlier segment targets outlined in June 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: AUTO1 Group Outlines Long-Term Merchant and Retail Segment Targets at 2026 Capital Markets Event
announcements.insight: AUTO1 Group outlines long-term segment targets at its 2026 Capital Markets Event. This follows the recent election of Jörg Pietzner to the Supervisory Board in June.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Jörg Pietzner elected as new AUTO1 Group Supervisory Board member
announcements.insight: Jörg Pietzner has been elected to the Supervisory Board. This board change may influence governance and oversight for Auto1 Group SE.
